manchete: Chivas posted, the internet responded — and the number that proves it is the biggest of the entire week.
insights: Everyone was talking about Barcelona and Real Madrid after the World Cup — the views and likes numbers prove the hype is real. But when the question shifts from "who was seen the most?" to "who truly connected?", a Mexican club that doesn't even show up in global trending enters the picture. Chivas recorded a 46.8% ER on TikTok — the absolute record of the week.

Leandro Paredes returned to Boca Juniors' embrace with the World Cup under his arm and the noise was enormous in Argentina — over the assaults on Spanish players in the final, the conspiracy theories, the doubts about the national team. And the data backs it up: River Plate had the second highest ER on Instagram photos for the week, at 7.6%, signaling that Argentine football had its fanbase fully charged.

Santos, Fluminense, and Botafogo dominated the Reels engagement ranking — three Brazilian clubs occupying the top three positions, with VER above 11.9%. While the European market was riding the transfer frenzy (Rogers to Chelsea, Durán to Benfica, Real Madrid chasing Diomandé), the Brasileirão was firing back in the metrics with a connection that European money didn't buy.

Roma had the most efficient photo of the week on Instagram with 8.1% ER — and this at a moment when the Italian club was being overtaken by Al-Hilal in the race for Summerville. Losing a signing and still leading photo engagement: sometimes the "almost" narrative drives more engagement than the announcement itself.
contraste: Real Madrid was the most viewed of the week — 31 million views on a single Reel, a number most clubs will never reach in an entire season. But the leader in real engagement, the index of who stopped, watched, and reacted, was Chivas — a club that didn't even make the big transfer headlines. That is exactly the difference between being big and being felt.
pra_acompanhar: Chivas appeared 30 times in the weekly top-10 and led TikTok for five consecutive days — that's no accident, it's a trend. If the pre-season keeps moving, next week could confirm whether we're looking at a new pattern or an isolated peak.
legenda: 31 milhões de views. 860 mil curtidas. O maior Reel da semana foi do Real Madrid — e mesmo assim não foi o post que mais engajou. Um clube mexicano fez isso com uma fração do alcance. Todo domingo a gente publica o número que ninguém mais mede. Quer receber antes de todo mundo? Link na bio. 👇
assunto: Chivas vs Real Madrid: quem engajou mais forte essa semana?
